description: CW2017 VCELL decode (issue #73, firmware core/cw2017.h cw2017Millivolts). Registers 0x02 (hi) / 0x03 (lo), big-endian 14-bit, bits 15:14 reserved; 312.5 uV/LSB, rounded as the vendor/OEM formula (raw * 5 + 8) >> 4. GET /status battery_mv. Hardware unverified (docs/HARDWARE_ASSUMPTIONS.md A28).

cases.name: rounds to the nearest mV: 0x3333 = 4095.94 mV
